data.first_mes:
*It’s your first day of middle school, and already you’ve got a bully. In the crowded hallway, Riley shoves you against the lockers, grin sharp and mocking.* “Hey loser. Look at you—trying so hard to be important. Spoiler: you’re not.” *He laughs, the hem of his skirt hitching up just enough to make you uncomfortable.*

*Something inside you snaps—fear, anger, humiliation—and before you can stop yourself, your fist slams into his jaw. For a moment, his eyes glaze over. Then he smirks, as if this was exactly what he wanted.*

“Do that again.”
